notes: Manual ch. 22: 'essentially identical' to the matched-pairs signed-rank test except for effect-size definition.
Manual Fig. 29 reproduces part of Table 4 of Shieh et al. (2007) (literature values, not G*Power outputs).

[completeness review 2026-10-03] Added A.R.E. branches for the Uniform parent (k = 1.0, manual A.R.E. table); previously listed as an allowed value but not enumerated, which contradicted the stated denominator rule (prune only by documented applicability constraints).

[second review pass 2026-10-03] Manual formula defects for the Lehmann and A.R.E. methods (ch. 23; ch. 22 refers to it), found by reproducing printed examples (scratch arithmetic in R 4.6.1, not reference evidence): (1) §23 defines p1 = P(X < 0), 'the probability to observe a negative value', but the printed moments are P(X > 0) (DOC-122: p1 = 0.5398278 = Φ(0.1) for a shift of +0.1; p2 = 0.5562315 = Φ(0.2/√2)). (2) Var(Vs) is printed with (p3 − p1²); only (p3 − p2²) reproduces DOC-122 (0.8000594 vs printed 0.8000589) and DOC-123 (0.8308343 vs 0.8308341); the printed term gives 0.777 and 0.716. (3) The power formula prints 1 − Φ[(c − a − E(Vs))/√Var] with a = 0.5 for continuity correction; DOC-126 (two-sided, corrected) is reproduced only with the conservative sign (c + 0.5): 0.8534953 vs printed 0.8534958 (printed sign gives 0.9013). (4) §23.5 gives the two-sample A.R.E. formula (t(Nk − 2), δ = d√(N1N2k/(N1+N2))); the one-sample form t(Nk − 1), δ = d√(Nk) matches DOC-125 within 1e-4 (0.73198 vs printed 0.7319), whereas the two-sample form gives 0.46 and 0.30 for DOC-124/125; the printed 0.923 of DOC-124 (Laplace, k = 3/2) is not reproduced by any variant tried (0.911-0.934; unrounded one-sample form 0.9276), so either the printed value or the assumed computation differs. These are consistency checks of the manual only; the engine contract must still be confirmed by application capture.

(4) §23.5 gives the two-sample A.R.E. formula (t(Nk − 2), δ = d√(N1N2k/(N1+N2))); the one-sample form t(Nk − 1), δ = d√(Nk) matches DOC-125 within 1e-4 (0.73198 vs printed 0.7319), whereas the two-sample form gives 0.46 and 0.30 for DOC-124/125; the printed 0.923 of DOC-124 (Laplace, k = 3/2) is not reproduced by any variant tried (0.911-0.934; unrounded one-sample form 0.9276), so either the printed value or the assumed computation differs.
